reason: An interactive terminal agent for Claude Code-style coding workflows, with streaming responses, tool interactions, session management, configurable model providers, and permission controls.

summaries.zh: 一款在终端中提供类 Claude Code 交互体验的智能体工具，支持流式模型响应、工具调用展示、会话恢复、兼容 OpenAI 的自定义模型提供商和权限控制。
summaries.en: An interactive terminal agent for Claude Code-style workflows with streaming model responses, tool-call displays, session resumption, OpenAI-compatible providers, and permission controls.

capabilities: Streaming model responses and tool-call display
Persistent session history and session resumption
Permission presets including workspace-write and danger-full-access
